body:
## What
- `hkb stats [--since 7d] [--json]`: tasks per status, attempts per outcome, mean attempt duration, spawns today vs daily cap, and — when the worker log contains Claude's final JSON (`total_cost_usd`) — spend per profile.
- One board query plus run comments of tasks updated in the window. No new state files.
title: hkb stats: attempts, outcomes and spend per board so paid profiles are never a surprise
